A major release: Forge Desk, previously called execution-view, now publishes its image to `ghcr.io/brunoorsolon/forge-desk`. Switch your image path when you upgrade. The old `ghcr.io/brunoorsolon/execution-view` path keeps its tags up to 2.0.5 and gets no new ones.

## Breaking

- **New image path.** Pull `ghcr.io/brunoorsolon/forge-desk:3`, or pin `3.0.0`, instead of `ghcr.io/brunoorsolon/execution-view`. The repository moved to [github.com/brunoorsolon/forge-desk](https://github.com/brunoorsolon/forge-desk); old repository URLs redirect.
- **The `execution-view` command is gone.** The CLI is installed only as `forge-desk`, so scripts and systemd units that call `execution-view` must call `forge-desk`. The Docker image's entrypoint is unaffected.
- **Theme and line mode reset once.** The web UI reads only its `forge-desk:*` browser keys, so it does not pick up a theme or line mode that 2.x saved. Choose them again after the upgrade.

## Changed

- **Tracker `User-Agent`.** GitHub and Gitea requests send `User-Agent: forge-desk`.
- **DOT export graph id.** DOT exports start with `digraph "forge-desk"`.
- **Server log line.** Startup logs `forge-desk listening on ...`.
- **Compose service and container.** `docker-compose.yml` names the service and the container `forge-desk`.
- **Help name.** Help and usage say `forge-desk`.

## New

- **Release publication (opt-in).** Forge Desk can push one approved annotated tag and create one stable Gitea release, with a private state volume, a login and dedicated credentials. A planning-only deployment needs none of it. Guide: [docs/RELEASES.md](https://github.com/brunoorsolon/forge-desk/blob/main/docs/RELEASES.md).

## Upgrading from 2.0.5

Config syntax, `EV_*` variables, API paths, shared planning URLs, planning login and export formats (apart from the DOT graph id) are unchanged. Change the image path. If you switch to the current compose files, remove the old container once with `docker rm -f execution-view` before `docker compose up -d`, because it still holds the port. Update anything that matches the old `User-Agent`, DOT graph id or log line, and replace a copied `skills/execution-view-issues/` with `skills/forge-desk-issues/`. Step by step: [docs/DEPLOYMENT.md](https://github.com/brunoorsolon/forge-desk/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md#upgrading).
